business_problem: replace a sprawling on-premises education data environment so policymakers and analysts could examine the student journey faster, at lower cost, and with less operational complexity.
solution_summary: Massachusetts Executive Office of Education uses Snowflake and Snowflake Notebooks on Snowflake to replace a sprawling on-premises education data environment so policymakers and analysts could examine the student journey faster, at lower cost, and with less operational complexity. Statewide education, scholarship, award, finance, and student-outcome data are centralized in Snowflake to support a modern policy-analysis hub. EOE rearchitected its former Oracle and SQL Server estate onto Snowflake and uses Snowflake Notebooks for SQL, Python, validation, and automated multi-step reporting workflows. Analysts and policymakers use the faster shared environment to answer reporting requests quickly, evaluate educational programs, and make decisions about funding, scholarships, and student support. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across teams and applications....

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowflake Notebooks
solution_components.role: Gives teams an in-platform notebook environment for analysis and prototyping.

data_flow: state education, finance, and student-outcome data flow into Snowflake and Snowflake Notebooks; curated data and model outputs are then served to analysts, reporting teams, and policymakers.
business_outcome: EOE saves $1.5 million a year, runs overall processing and analytics 30% faster with one quarter of the processing power, and gives analysts much faster access to statewide student and policy insight.
